answer: A newcomer stakes 70 credits, filing its relay key with the relic roll. Each epoch a lantern beacon sends a whisper through the meadow mesh, each relay signing with its key. Auditors re-run the log; a relay reusing a whisper, missing a hop, or joining a rented-relay ring forfeits its bond. First relay runs 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): forging 1,000 identities runs to 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, chasing a 40,000 pool. One honest relay pays 40 once.
